The three typos found by the two LLM bots seemed real, so I fixed them in the wiki

Pulled them in here

ACK 6742347981d193ee8c75f985fe68b6a716a1f569

A few of the release notes do not use "#" links e.g. "(31560)" which we might want to update, if those are used anywhere else.
